quotes.text: we choose PubMedQA ( Jin et al., 2019 ) , MMLU

rationale: The paper names multiple original datasets and platforms such as PubMedQA, MMLU, BioASQ, and MedQA. It does not report dataset versions/snapshot dates or a route from an individual CAB task to its original source record.

quotes.text: All patient data has been anonymized, and informed consent was obtained for its use

rationale: The benchmark reports data origin through named source datasets and includes consent/anonymization and ethics approval language. It does not fully document licensing or terms compliance for the assembled benchmark.

quotes.text: randomly sample the 1000 instances from the public part of the dataset and keep the data component proportions

rationale: The paper reports sampling design details for some datasets and task construction. It does not compare key patient features against a named clinical target population.

quotes.text: we choose four types of datasets to validate the trustworthiness

rationale: The Trustworthiness dimension is a dedicated hallucination/unsafe-output style evaluation. The packet does not report a bias test.
